data.desc: Niki BioSolutions is a clinical-stage life sciences company focused on addressing unmet medical needs by developing high-quality genomic and biomarker testing solutions to healthcare providers, research institutions, and life sciences organizations. Through its CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited laboratory, the Company combines proprietary technologies with scientific rigor to support precision medicine across a range of therapeutic areas. Niki BioSolutions collaborates with leading academic centers, disease foundations, and biopharmaceutical companies.
